launch_claim_boundary: This model bounds beta storage and ingest assumptions. It is not live soak proof until scripts/run_beta_intake_soak_test.py is run against the target intake endpoint and its report is archived.

cost_per_capture_model.claim_boundary: Configured planning assumptions for beta budgeting; this is not provider invoice, GCP billing export, or live soak proof.

firestore_created_at_hotspot_policy.claim_boundary: This declares webapp-owned index manifest entries, pipeline alerting, and soak-report evidence fields. It is not live Firestore latency proof and does not prove readers already fan out per-shard queries.
firestore_created_at_hotspot_policy.v1_correction: v1 pinned four pipeline Terraform indexes on a literal `captures` collection that no repo has ever written. Those phantom resources are deleted; the real capture-record collection is creatorCaptures, written by Blueprint-WebApp (server/routes/creator.ts), whose writer has populated createdAtShard since scaling round 1.
scale_up_sharded_indexes: creatorCaptures: creator_id ASC, createdAtShard ASC, created_at DESC
creatorCaptures: status ASC, createdAtShard ASC, created_at ASC
firestore_created_at_hotspot_policy.writer: Blueprint-WebApp server/routes/creator.ts capture registration via server/utils/captureShard.ts
firestore_created_at_hotspot_policy.writer_note: Blueprint-WebApp creator capture registration writes createdAtShard on new capture records; backfill of pre-existing records is a separate migration.
firestore_created_at_hotspot_policy.reader_requirement_before_scale_up: Aggregate per-shard created_at result sets before removing the legacy created_at composite.
firestore_created_at_hotspot_policy.legacy_index_removal_requirement: After sharded reader migration is proven, remove composites that still route high-rate creatorCaptures queries directly through monotonically increasing created_at.

gpu_warm_pool_policy.cold_start_tax_reduction: in-process model runtime cache + gpu_model_load timing events (src/blueprint_pipeline/privacy_service_runtime.py)
gpu_warm_pool_policy.revisit_trigger: sustained per-service invocation rate >= 10/hour, a live/interactive latency SLO, GPU pricing change, or measured cold-start tax >= $500/month
gpu_warm_pool_policy.threshold_review_requirement: Any min_instances > 0 flip must be paired with a review of the $2,500/$5,000 provider-spend thresholds: one warm instance alone is ~73% of the review threshold.
gpu_warm_pool_policy.claim_boundary: Modeled from the $2.5/GPU-hr planning rate and an assumed 3-minute cold start; the owner must sanity-check invocation rates and measured gpu_model_load durations against real metrics before flipping any min-instances variable.

beta_data_retention_policy.claim_boundary: This points launch artifacts at the declared beta data retention policy. It is not signed DPA, live bucket lifecycle apply proof, or user-deletion execution proof.

storage_lifecycle.raw_archive_rationale: Raw capture truth is never lifecycle-deleted; it moves to ARCHIVE at 365 days. At 10k locations x ~1.2 GiB raw p50 (~12 TiB), ARCHIVE at $0.0012/GiB-month is roughly $15/month, negligible versus recapture cost, and preserves capture data for future world-model training per WORLD_MODEL_STRATEGY_CONTEXT.md Data Priority.

local_robot_eval_jobs_retention.canonical_handoff_rule: Repo-root robot_eval_jobs entries are local cache snapshots; they are not launch proof unless selected by the current launch readiness packet or copied into a current operator evidence bundle.
local_robot_eval_jobs_retention.claim_boundary: This local retention plan controls developer-machine disk pressure and operator handoff hygiene. It is not GCS lifecycle proof, legal deletion proof, or live provider result validity.

required_before_external_beta: run validator on the committed model and lifecycle file
apply lifecycle policy to the primary capture bucket
run intake soak harness against staging or production target at target_concurrent_uploaders
archive soak JSON report under output/beta_capacity/
